text:
sara: Quick check — Paris private region (par) readiness. Need owners for routing policy, KMS wiring, and the canary window. Can folks ack ownership + ETA? :eyes:

jonathan: I can take routing policy work. ETA for PRs: tests by Tue, routing PR by Wed. Which CIDR/prefixes are we using?

maria: I'll own KMS wiring and key policy. Need service account list and if we require external HSM. ETA Thu for key provisioning.

cheng: @jonathan + @maria I own the network peering and firewall rules. I'll coordinate peering with cloud-net. Peering ticket: TICKET-876.

sara: Great. Action items: jonathan - routing PR + test plan, maria - KMS key + access matrix, cheng - peering + firewall. Can we aim for canary deploy Fri 12:00 UTC? :calendar:

jonathan: FYI PR is opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4121 . Needs review from @elaine for policy lints.

elaine: Reviewing now, will comment by EOD. Quick note — route policy needs to include residency tag header. Example:
```
route {
  prefix = "par-1"
  residency = "eu"
}
```

jonathan: ack, will add residency header.

maria: KMS note: customer keys will be in kms-par-prod, but for canary will use kms-par-staging. Need access list from platform services: [redwood-serve, redwood-console, redwood-ops]. Can @sara confirm service account names?

sara: Confirmed: redwood-serve-prod, redwood-console-prod, redwood-ops. For staging append `-staging`.

cheng: Peering window requested for Fri 03:00-05:00 UTC, marking maintenance. Will post more in infra channel when approved.

sara: OK. Who can own the rollback plan if latency/regression observed? Suggested owner: @elaine or @jonathan.

elaine: I can own rollback steps (routing revert + KMS key fallback). I'll draft runbook and link here by Thu.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: par-region-canary-2026-02-14, canary window Fri 12:00 UTC, rollback window Fri 12:30 UTC. See runbook: https://runbooks.internal/par-canary

sara: Thanks everyone. Linking dependencies list:
- PR: 4121 (routing)
- PR: 4122 (kms configs)
- Ticket: TICKET-876 (peering)
Please update status here as you make progress. :thumbsup:
